lifecycle.start: blocking primary, clearance threshold, best executable Gamma >= 2*gamma_min
lifecycle.reselect: search again below threshold; pause if no direction reaches startup threshold
lifecycle.exit: goal segment clear of all safety spheres, primary clearance nondecreasing, raw nominal admissible in continuous K; all confirmed for tau_off
lifecycle.confirmation: first observed true predicate credits zero elapsed time; interruptions reset timer
lifecycle.fixed_direction: Same lifecycle; a preset horizontal LOS-normal direction is transported during holding. No Gamma direction optimization.

execution_scope.transport: fine-step numerical approximation; no bit-level proof claimed
execution_scope.certificate_failure: not certified; not equivalent to QP infeasibility

formal_experiment_execution.parameter_override_policy: Formal batches must not use unrecorded --dt/--nu/--cruise/--tr overrides.
formal_experiment_execution.required_before_formal_batch: A batch-specific frozen runner must record the exact command, every override, the final effective configuration, source hashes and input hashes before execution.

current_phase.scope_note: These are current-hash mechanism/corridor runs, not the final four-method statistical campaign.
